settings.api_token_help: Create a personal access token at https://github.com/settings/tokens/new with the read:user, user:email and read:org scopes. This token is used to fetch your sponsor information from GitHub.
settings.account_type_help: Select whether you're tracking sponsors for a personal GitHub user account or an organization account.
settings.login_help: Enter your GitHub username (for user accounts) or organization name (for organizations). This is the account whose sponsors will be synchronized.
settings.group_help: Select which Flarum user group active monthly sponsors should be added to. Users are added when they start sponsoring monthly, and moved to the one-time group (if configured) when their monthly sponsorship ends.
settings.onetime_group_help: Select which Flarum user group one-time sponsors and past monthly sponsors should be added to. If not set, they are not managed.

status.heading: Sync status
status.never_run: The sync has not run yet. It runs hourly through Flarum's scheduler, so check that the scheduler is set up.
status.stale: The last sync was more than two hours ago. Check that Flarum's scheduler is running.
status.test_success: Connected to {maintainer} as {account}. {sponsorships} public sponsorships found.
status.request_failed: The connection test could not be run.

reasons.unauthorized: GitHub rejected the token. It may have expired or been revoked.
reasons.forbidden: The token is missing a required scope. It needs "read:user", "user:email" and "read:org".
reasons.not_found: GitHub user or organization not found. Check the account type and login.
reasons.rate_limited: GitHub's rate limit was reached. The next sync will try again.
reasons.configuration: The token, account type, login or group settings are incomplete.
reasons.no_sponsors: GitHub returned no sponsors, so nothing was changed. Run the sync with --force if this is correct.

fof_github_sponsors.recurring_started: {username} became a monthly sponsor on GitHub. Groups: {old_groups} → {new_groups}
fof_github_sponsors.onetime_started: {username} became a one-time sponsor on GitHub. Groups: {old_groups} → {new_groups}
fof_github_sponsors.sponsorship_ended: {username} is no longer a GitHub sponsor. Groups: {old_groups} → {new_groups}
fof_github_sponsors.groups_changed: GitHub Sponsors sync changed {username}'s groups from {old_groups} to {new_groups}
fof_github_sponsors.membership_adopted: GitHub Sponsors sync took over {username}'s membership of {new_groups}

githubsponsor.export_description: Exports the member's GitHub sponsor status, when it last changed, and the groups the sync manages for them.
githubsponsor.delete_description: Deletes the member's GitHub sponsor record, so the sync forgets them without announcing the end of their sponsorship.
